title: TelemetryReport
description: A derived rollup OVER 1..N SessionExport files (plan 047 Phase 2). Answers 'across these sessions, where did the time and tokens go?' — it is NOT a session and NOT an eval RunRecord. Every dimension derives from the ONE lossless event stream a SessionExport carries (otlpLogsToEvents(signals.logs)); counts are EXACT, time/tokens are ESTIMATES with a declared `attribution`. Additive: additionalProperties:true + a pinned schema_version so a new dimension/facet is a new key, never a breaking change.

schema_version.description: Pinned envelope version. Bump on a field-set change.

session_count.description: How many sessions were rolled up.

single.description: true ⇒ a one-session report (the only N=1-vs-N>1 shape difference).

session_ids.description: harness_session_ids rolled up (may be capped ⇒ provenance.session_count is authoritative).

filter.description: What narrowed this report — echoed for self-description. An absent field = that facet unfiltered. `repo` is ECHO-ONLY (a SessionExport carries no repo facet in v1; repo narrowing is Phase 3 / workshop 004).

totals.description: The headline numbers (FX002). time_s = Σ per-session ACTIVE time (agent+human, idle excluded); tokens = non-cache {input, output}; cache = session-level context re-reads (never per-dimension).

cache.description: Context re-reads (cache), session-level ONLY — labelled, never attributed per-dimension.

read.description: cache_read — the model re-reading its context.

create.description: cache_create — context written to the cache.

friction.description: plan 056 (workshop D6) — friction proxies: non-zero command_exit + api_error counts (the observe→friction conversion denominator). Optional/additive.

observe_events.description: plan 056 — `harness observe` invocations across the cohort (the conversion numerator).

retro.description: plan 056 — retro-drain aggregates from `retro` artifact events. Counts-only; zero until schema-1.2 records are drained.

rollups.description: Every dimension, the SAME row shape. Additive: a new dimension is a new key old readers ignore. v1 ships flow_stage / skill / tool / bash_command / harness_command.

bash_command.description: Shell-family tool runs keyed by the captured command signature — program+verb only, P12-safe (e.g. `rg`, `git commit`) — when available, else the shell-tool name (`bash`/`shell`) for older signature-less data. EXCLUDES `harness …` invocations (co-timed harness events) to avoid double-count. The workshop-002 `rg ×54` ask is met at signature granularity via FX001; only the signature, never full argv, is stored (P12).

harness_command.description: ⭐ The prominent, dedicated dimension — in-stream `harness` event verbs (e.g. `doctor`, `flow nav`).

attribution.description: How to read the numbers — never mistake an estimate for a ledger. `bash_command_key` + `notes` are ALWAYS emitted (the command-signature-or-tool-name / no-double-count contract is self-describing), so both are required.

tokens.description: e.g. 'turn-window-even-split' — a turn's tokens attribute to the dimension(s) active in its window, split evenly (v1).

time.description: e.g. 'timeline-bracket' — wall-clock between consecutive timeline events (flow_stage uses computeRollup stage windowing).

bash_command_key.description: 'shell-command-signature-or-tool-name' — keys by the captured program+verb signature (`rg`, `git commit`) when available, else the shell-tool name; never full argv (P12 / FX001).

provenance.description: Rendered at the bottom of the HTML — exactly what data backs the numbers. source_paths are repo-relative / home-stripped (never an absolute /Users/… path — P12).

flow_stage_map_version.description: The pinned versioned semantic stage-map (node id → research/plan/implement/review/ship) applied to the flow_stage lens (T1.4/D3).

flow_stage_mechanism.description: Per-window labeling mechanism counts for the flow_stage lens (T1.4 + 057 T003): flow_log = cursor-moved flow_log transition marks (last-transition lookup, richest); flow = nav-derived FlowEvent (primary); digit = /the-flow <n> bracket (fallback); unlabeled = /the-flow call with neither, or events before the first mark.

token_coverage.description: Sessions with real token data vs a DECLARED token gap (T1.6/AC-04): a v2.0-era thin shard (turns with no usage attrs) is `unmeasured`, never a fabricated zero. measured + unmeasured == session_count.

control_timeline.description: SINGLE-session reports ONLY (plan 048 Phase 2): the ordered, closed-allowlist control-marker stream the insights discipline panel + subagent section consume. Absent on cohort/aggregate reports. Each marker carries exactly one already-captured, P12-safe discriminant (a verb / status / agent slug / branch / git push|commit signature) — never args, paths, or content.

authorship.description: plan 056 — per-file write/edit deltas aggregated from the `file` events across every included session ('which files did agents write, and how much'). Absent when no session carried a `file` event.

path.description: Repo-relative path, or the literal `<external>` for an out-of-repo write (confined at serialize time — never a leaked absolute path).

change.description: The most recent change kind observed for the path.

events.description: How many `file` events (writes/edits) touched this path.

timelineMarker.description: One ordered control marker. `key` is the P12-safe discriminant per kind: harness→verb, checks→status, subagent→name, branch→to, bash→a git push/commit signature.

kind.description: CLOSED allowlist — no other event kind may surface (the timeline is a control stream, not an event dump).

rollupTokens.description: Per-dimension tokens (FX002): non-cache {input, output}, kept SEPARATE. input = fresh (non-cached) input; output = generated tokens. cache_read/cache_create are NEVER per-dimension (session-level only — totals.cache).

rollupEntry.description: One row — identical across every dimension so the HTML renders them uniformly. time_s is present ONLY for the time-bearing lenses (skill / flow_stage); command rows (tool / bash_command / harness_command) OMIT it (no honest per-call duration — FX002).

time_s.description: ESTIMATE (active, idle-excluded) — skill/flow_stage only; absent on command rows.

semantic_stage.description: flow_stage lens ONLY (T1.4): the versioned semantic-map projection of `key`; omitted when the label has no mapping (a bare digit / unlabeled).

time_s.description: Present only for the time-bearing lenses (skill / flow_stage).

truncated.description: Rows dropped past a --top cap — surfaced, never silent.
